mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4% over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing activity and earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
